items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer lists Earl Hines in a poll ranking ('After you comes Earl Hines...'), and the interviewee does not provide any personal anecdote or confirmation of a direct professional or personal relationship with Hines.

ctx.x: And of course, who would always be, as the years went on, right at the beginning, you had Earl Bostic and Luther West and they were all there and if anybody could compete with them, they were pretty darn good.
Earl, as far as a soloist, he was just tops.
